name: memory-context-intelligence
description: Claude Code plugin for guided configuration, eligibility-gated evidence-first historical analysis, and manual research-informed principle synthesis. Analysis asks only for missing period/topic-target choices and stays inside 1-14 calendar days including today. Incremental analysis starts at the oldest unprocessed trace in that window and advances MCI-owned progress only after caller-attested completion of each bounded batch, including successful zero-topic analysis. Explicit catch-up freezes that window and one invocation endpoint; explicit narrow inspection remains non-advancing. Canonical minimized evidence, strict novelty/deduplication, privacy and one-topic-per-artifact approval boundaries remain. Corpus, Memsearch state and Main RULES are not mutated by analysis. Source/local fixture proof is separate from installation, native model behavior and measured benefit.
